block_row: Structural top: ports, interconnect and named instances only.

frame_row: Structural top of the asynchronous two-phase handshake IP.

label: u_src
(m_vlsit_ahs2_src)
blocks.function: Request toggle, payload register, acknowledge synchronizer, and return-payload output selection.

label: u_dst
(m_vlsit_ahs2_dst)
blocks.function: Request synchronizer, accept detection, payload capture, acknowledge toggle, and optional ready and return registers.

interfaces.name: Source request interface (requester side)
interfaces.signals: external -> TOP: i_req, i_data; TOP -> u_src: i_req, i_data

interfaces.name: Source return-payload interface
interfaces.signals: u_src -> TOP: o_ack_data; TOP -> external: o_ack_data

interfaces.name: Request toggle and bundled payload crossing, CDC-001 and CDC-003
Destination data interface (completer side)
interfaces.signals: u_dst -> TOP: o_data; TOP -> external: o_data

interfaces.name: Destination accept level and acknowledge-toggle crossing, CDC-002 and CDC-004
interfaces.signals: external -> TOP: i_ack; TOP -> u_dst: i_ack; u_dst -> u_src: reg_ack (w_ack); u_dst -> u_src: reg_ack_data (w_ack_data)

interfaces.name: Destination return-payload input
interfaces.signals: external -> TOP: i_ack_data; TOP -> u_dst: i_ack_data

interfaces.name: Source clock and reset
interfaces.signals: SoC -> TOP: i_clk_src, i_rst_n_src; TOP -> u_src: i_clk_src, i_rst_n_src

interfaces.name: Destination clock and reset
interfaces.signals: SoC -> TOP: i_clk_dst, i_rst_n_dst; TOP -> u_dst: i_clk_dst, i_rst_n_dst

legend_note: The enclosing frame is the top module; the two blocks are its instances. The synchronizer instances u_sync_req and u_sync_ack are inside u_dst and u_src respectively. The request toggle and the bundled payload cross from u_src to u_dst on the drawn REQ connector. The acknowledge toggle and the bundled return payload cross back from u_dst to u_src and are listed in the DACK row of the interface table, because the forward and return crossings share one block boundary. Both cross-domain control signals are one-bit toggles through m_vlsit_afifo_cell_sync; both payloads are held for the whole handshake.
